meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude 在每次回答前会自动调取之前对话中相关记忆，回答后会把新信息保存下来。记忆存放在专用文件夹，容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 当代理使用默认 Claude 提供者时，每次回应前自动回忆相关旧对话，每轮结束后自动保存新见解。

say.text: 还记得我上次提到的项目进展吗？
say.note: 它会从记忆里调出相关旧上下文。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的会议时间记住。
say.note: 对话结束后会自动存入记忆。

say.text: 结合我们之前聊过的偏好，给个建议。
say.note: 回答前会先检索相关记忆。

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude automatically recalls relevant past context before each response and saves new insights after each turn. Memory persists across container restarts in a dedicated folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the agent runs the default Claude provider: before each response and after each turn.

say_en.text: Remember my project progress from last time?
say_en.note: It will pull up relevant past context.

say_en.text: Note the meeting time we just discussed.
Use what you know about my preferences to suggest something.
